description: Isolates response-elicitation format (mc menu / plan template / open free-text memo) as its own controlled variable, holding scenario content, cue level, and payoff fixed within each matched triple. The star family, elicitation_scaffold (66 items, 22 matched triples across all 11 Charter rules x 2 cue levels), tests whether prior attempts' choice-scaffold formats (mc/plan) are themselves a cue that changes measured discrimination relative to an open-ended settlement memo scored by which option's name the model uses. The remaining families (cue_ladder, blacklist_exception, coin_gap, displacement, leakage, fabrication, consistency, multi_hop, pressure, agentic, paraphrase, direct_floor) give the guide's playbook real, independently-built coverage at a scale smaller than the star family so the format comparison isn't diluted.
